children: SoftBank is listing its aspiring data-center firm, perhaps for $50 bln. It’s a great time to sell, as computing power is scarce. Investing is another matter, as most of SB Energy’s promised revenue is years away, and reliance on OpenAI and related-party deals merit skepticism.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Karen Kwok on LinkedIn and X.

SB Energy recorded a 66.4% jump in revenue in the first half ​of 2026 to $139 million, the SoftBank-backed data center developer disclosed on September 1 in a securities filing for its U.S. initial public offering. The company's operating loss in the first six months of the year widened to $552 million, from $181 million in the same period a year ago.
SB Energy plans to sell new shares. Reuters reported on May 26 that the company could seek a valuation of more than $50 billion in its IPO.
